Name: I Live in This Place
Description: Submit a band or artist that comes from the town where you currently live. If your locale is too small or uncool to have produced a band, the next major urban conurbation will do. Please name the town in the comments.

Name: Jenny
Description: A song whose title is a person’s first name, no second name, no other words.

Name: Son
Description: A song by an artist or a band including an artist that is the son/daughter of another recognised artist.

Name: Lost My Humor
Description: In a nightmare for Sparks haters and quite possibly the worst round yet, a song that is intended to be amusing.

Name: Aspirin
Description: Very slow songs.  This is not a race (an anti-race).  Prizes should not be given to the *slowest* songs,  Just the best songs that happen to be really slow. However, you may choose to downvote a song you consider too fast.

Name: Leave Her Alone
Description: A song title that takes the form of an instruction.

Name: Tomorrow
Description: A song title that refers to a time in the future, eg next week, next month, some day soon, in the year XXXX, when I’m older etc.

Name: Sleep
Description: Songs about being asleep or literally dreaming/nightmares (not just as a metaphor), but not including coma or hallucinations. If it’s not obvious from the title, please explain in your comment how the song is relevant to the theme.

Name: Hollywood 4-5-92
Description: A song that was (for you) memorably used in a movie or TV show. Please state the movie/show in your comment, and the context if you can remember it.

Name: Friend of the Devil
Description: A song title or band/artist name that includes the word ‘devil’ or an appropriate variation (Satan, Beelzebub etc).
